en: The European System of Central Banks. Functional and institutional aspects Main points of the intervention of Eugenio Domingo Solans in the summer course of the Complutensian University of Madrid Aguadulce (Almería), 9 July 1998 The main decision to take in particular the European Central Bank (ECB) is to take into account the least appropriate monetary policy strategy. A combined strategy of direct inflation objectives with medium monetary objectives appears to be the best option, at least at the beginning of the third phase of the EMU. The stability of the euro area as a whole is the key element for the implementation of the euro area, and the application of the budget is the following: Its level will be between 1.5% and 2.5% of the computer base, it will be admitted to a reduction in the order of EUR 100,000 and will be paid in line with the type of interest of the ECB's main refinancing operations. At the institutional level, the basic element for the success of the ECB is independence.
